doc: enemy-ai stations for the arena: the pit waves and the 00:00 sample fight on the cast rigs. The arena lane reads these; until it lands, res://dev/enemy_ai/enemy_pit_view.tscn (debug draw) and res://dev/enemy_ai/enemy_rig_fight_run.gd (cast rigs, D5 look) run them.

stations.doc: The open pit with cover: the wave spawner runs waves.json-style rows from enemies.json against Rivet.

The owner's 00:00 sample, enemy half: a patrol cop (pistol, aim-line tell) and a robot thug (claw: windup, lunge along the locked aim, swing), already alert, staged by PitLayout.place: Rivet at (-5, 0) m, patrol_cop at (9, -6), robot_thug at (-1, 2.5). Run on the cast rigs: enemy_rig_fight_run.gd -- --spots=9:-6,-1:2.5 --fire_m=10.
